name: HoloX Directive

boost.name: Orders from HQ
effect: +1 Power and draw a card.
HIT: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 to your hand, put the other on the bottom.
description: 以祕密結社holoX女幹部的指揮權限為概念。命中後可檢視牌組頂端並調整戰術，表現Lui作為實質領導者的情報管理能力與戰略規劃。

name: PON Surprise

boost.name: Wait, What?
effect: Discard a card. If you do, draw 2 cards.
BEFORE: If you have fewer cards in hand than your opponent, +3 Power.
HIT: Your opponent discards a random card.
description: 以Lui的天然呆(PON)特質為靈感。看似失誤的意外高速攻擊，手牌劣勢時反而威力更強，表現她「關鍵時刻搞砸卻意外製造機會」的反差萌。Boost象徵她搞錯事情後慌忙補救的樣子。

name: K Time

boost.name: Klarity Mode
effect: +2 Power and Ignore Armor.
BEFORE: Close 2.
Ignore Guard.
HIT: Gain Advantage.
description: 來自Lui偶爾進入的極度專注狀態「K Time（清晰模式）」。精準無比的近距離打擊，無視對手防禦，展現她在混亂中瞬間冷靜下來、展現真正實力的瞬間。

name: Wilted Rose

boost.name: Bloom Someday
effect: +2 Armor and Stun Immunity.
AFTER: Gain 1 Force.
If this card is in your discard at the end of your turn, you may add it to your hand.
description: 以Lui的粉絲標誌——枯萎的玫瑰🥀為概念。她自認「還不是綻放的花朵」，此卡表現她在逆境中累積力量、等待綻放的姿態。高防禦、可在回合結束從墓地回收，象徵永不放棄的堅持。

name: Don't Drop Your Water

boost.name: Spill the Tea
effect: Discard up to 2 cards. Your opponent discards the same number.
BEFORE: If you have a 'PON' card in your discard, +2 Power.
HIT: Push 1.
description: 以Lui的知名哏——打翻水在鍵盤上——為設計基礎。防禦型的近距離反擊，Boost讓她可以「潑水」迫使對手也棄牌，呼應她「Don't drop your water.」的自嘲台詞。與PON Surprise有連攜效果。

name: Cold Joke

boost.name: So Cold...
effect: NOW: Your opponent discards a card if they have 4 or more cards in hand.
HIT: Your opponent cannot use Boost effects until the end of their next turn.
description: 以Lui喜歡講冷笑話後全場結凍的經典場面為靈感。命中後封鎖對手Boost能力，如同她的笑話讓氣氛瞬間凍結。Boost反應聽眾聽了冷笑話後想丟東西的反應。

name: Hype Luivels Rising

boost.name: Did I Luive You Waiting!?
effect: Draw 1 card.
AFTER: If you have Advantage, draw 1 more card.
HIT: Gain Advantage.
description: 來自Lui的口頭禪「Hype Luivels rising!」和「Did I Luive you waiting!?」。高速靈活的牽制技，命中後搶回先手權，配合她的諧音哏(Luive = Lui + Live)，表現她炒熱氣氛的活力。

name: Executive Secretary

boost.name: Reorganize
effect: Return any number of cards from your hand to your deck. Shuffle. Draw that many cards.
BEFORE: Search your deck for a card with 'Lui' or 'holoX' in its name, reveal it, and add it to your hand. Shuffle.
description: 以Lui作為holoX女幹部處理日常營運的秘書長形象為設計。以組織與重整手牌為核心，能檢索牌組中的關鍵卡牌，表現她擅長策略規劃與資源調度的能力。

name: I Take Your Luive

boost.name: Luive & Laugh
effect: +1 Power for each card in your hand.
HIT: Gain Advantage.
Cannot be guarded if you have 5 or more cards in hand.
HIT: Your opponent discards down to 3 cards in hand.
description: 以Lui的收尾台詞「I take your Luive.」(おつるいるい)為靈感的超級攻擊。手牌充足時不可防禦，表現她「在大家沒注意到的時候已經收工了」的瀟灑感，命中後強制對手縮減手牌，如同她的公關手腕乾淨俐落。

name: Secret Society's True Leader

boost.name: The XO's Orders
effect: NOW: You may play a card from your discard with 'holoX' or 'Lui' in its name without paying its Force cost.
HIT: Return all cards from your discard to your deck. Shuffle. Draw 3 cards.
description: 呼應Lui作為祕密結社holoX真正營運核心的地位。壓倒性的全局重置效果——命中後將墓地所有牌回收並抽牌，象徵她以女幹部的權限重整組織。Boost可免費從墓地施展holoX卡片，表現她號令全社的力量。
